mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM advertiser_catalog_schema_history WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND version=#{version}
SELECT ad_id FROM ad WHERE advertiser_id=#{owner} AND ad_id>#{after} ORDER BY ad_id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM catalog_task_item WHERE AND target_kind=#{kind} AND target_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM catalog_task_item WHERE AND target_kind='FANOUT_AD' AND state IN ('READY','DISPATCHED') ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM catalog_task_item WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND state IN ('READY','DISPATCHED') AND available_at<=clock_timestamp() ORDER BY available_at,updated_at,ordinal LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM catalog_task_item WHERE AND ordinal>#{after} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) AS total,coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS completed, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state='CONFLICT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS conflicts, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state='CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS cancelled, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state='PAUSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS paused, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state IN ('READY','DISPATCHED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending FROM catalog_task_item WHERE AND target_kind IN ('FANOUT_AD','STATUS_OWNER')
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='DISPATCHED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='FANOUT_AD' AND target_id=#{id} AND state='READY'
UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='COMPLETED',result_bytes=#{result},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='FANOUT_AD' AND target_id=#{id} AND state='DISPATCHED'

UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='DISPATCHED',attempts=attempts+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND target_id=#{id} AND state IN ('READY','DISPATCHED') AND attempts<3
UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='DISPATCHED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND target_id=#{id} AND state IN ('READY','DISPATCHED')

UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state=#{state},phase=#{phase},result_bytes=#{result},error_type=#{error},attempts=0,available_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '500 milliseconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND target_id=#{id} AND state='DISPATCHED'

UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state=CASE WHEN attempts=3 THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE 'DISPATCHED' END,error_type=#{error},available_at=clock_timestamp()+catalog_backoff(attempts,child_command_id::text),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND target_id=#{id} AND state='DISPATCHED'
UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='PAUSED',error_type='ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND target_id=#{id} AND state='DISPATCHED' AND attempts=3

UPDATE catalog_command SET state='PAUSED',result_bytes=#{result},lease_until=NULL,error_type='PARTIAL',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND state='RUNNING' AND fence=#{fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='CANCELLED',result_bytes=#{result},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND state='READY'

UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='DISPATCHED',round=round+1,attempts=0,error_type=NULL,available_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND target_id=#{id} AND state='PAUSED' AND round=#{round}

UPDATE catalog_command SET state='ADMITTED',round=round+1,attempts=0,fence=fence+1,phase='BATCH_WORK',active_step='BATCH_WORK',frozen_bytes=#{frozen},result_bytes=NULL,error_type=NULL,lease_until=NULL,available_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND state='PAUSED' AND round=#{round} AND fence=#{fence}
mapper.select: SELECT count(1)>0 FROM catalog_command WHERE AND phase='BATCH_OBSERVE' AND attempts=3 AND state IN ('ADMITTED','RUNNING','PAUSED') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_task_item SET state='PAUSED',error_type='OBSERVATION_LEASE_EXHAUSTED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND target_kind='STATUS_OWNER' AND target_id=#{id} AND state='DISPATCHED'

UPDATE catalog_command SET state='ADMITTED',phase='BATCH_WORK',active_step='BATCH_WORK',attempts=0,fence=fence+1,lease_until=NULL,frozen_bytes=#{frozen},available_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE AND phase='BATCH_OBSERVE' AND fence=#{fence} AND attempts=3 AND state IN ('ADMITTED','RUNNING','PAUSED') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp())
